```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Medium severity alarm indication
    Given the alarm severity is set to medium
    When the alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm indicator should be yellow
    And the alarm frequency should be 0.5Hz with a 50% duty cycle

  Scenario: High severity alarm auditory signal
    Given the alarm severity is set to high
    When the alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm should produce 10 pulses with each pulse lasting 200ms and a frequency of 500Hz

  Scenario: High severity alarm auditory signal with 4 pulses
    Given the alarm severity is set to high
    When the alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm should produce 4 pulses with each pulse lasting 200ms and a frequency of 500Hz

  Scenario: Audio pause/alarm pause key press
    Given the audio pause/alarm pause key is pressed
    When the key press is registered
    Then all active alarms should be paused for 60 seconds
    And the alarm activation symbol should be displayed with the IEC 60417-5576 symbol

  Scenario: Apnea alarm
    Given the apnea time interval has expired
    When the ventilator is triggered
    Then a medium priority alarm should be triggered with the display text "APNEA ALARM"

  Scenario: Breath rate alarm
    Given the breath rate has exceeded the breath rate setting
    When the ventilator is triggered
    Then a medium level alarm should be triggered with the display text "HIGH BREATH RATE"

  Scenario: Maximum breath rate setting
    Given the breath rate setting is set to the maximum
    When the ventilator is triggered
    Then a medium level alarm should be triggered with the display text "HIGH BREATH RATE"

  Scenario: Pressure low alarm
    Given the pressure is low
    When the ventilator is triggered
    Then a high severity alarm should be triggered with the display text "LOW INSP P"
```
